intended_object: An "operator gauge" on the bounded operators E →L[𝕜] F. It is an extended seminorm g : L(E,F) → [0,∞] that is subadditive and absolutely homogeneous and that dominates the operator norm (‖A‖ ≤ g(A)). This is the kind of extended norm that defines Schatten, nuclear or p-summing classes in the style of Pietsch, Ch. 6. The description comes from the docstring and the module documentation.
